glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 一 (“one, signifying a number”) + phonetic 人. The Old Chinese pronunciations of 千 and 人 were similar. For the component 人, compare its combining form 亻. The traditional explanation holds that the extra line indicates an extension (see the etymologies of 年 and 延). 千 has the meaning one thousand because one thousand is a number that is reached by extending one's counting.
